diff: The Forum post for the associated Spell or deployment must include a link to each applicable final audit report, the audited commit hash, and confirmation that the deployed code matches the audited commit, as specified in [A.1.10.2.3.2.1.2.1.2.1 - Requirements For Forum Post](3d031b7c-1b1f-4f84-8668-1cdf43cb2ab2). Where a Technical Scope is submitted for the deployment, the final audit report and audited commit hash must also be included in the Technical Scope as specified in the same requirements.
